targets.purpose: SQL script to create 'staging' schema in the existing Supabase project, clone tables/data from 'public', grant RLS permissions, and add official_locations & location_mode columns for Loca-V2 testing.
Additive migration script for when Loca-V2 is eventually merged into main (public schema) without breaking Cloudflare Pages.
Add SUPABASE_SCHEMA = 'staging' (isolated schema support using existing URL & Key), add default official_locations array and updated remarks.
Pass db: { schema: Config.SUPABASE_SCHEMA || 'public' } to createClient so all models automatically target 'staging' schema with zero changes to queries.
Support official_locations and remarks in getSettings() and updateSettings() with Stale-While-Revalidate localStorage fallback.
Add Tab 6 'สถานที่และรัศมี' (tab-panel-locations) in settingsTabNav and its CRUD table/modal container for managing multiple Official Locations & Radius (meters) with map/GPS picker.
Implement renderLocations(), add/edit/delete official locations modal (name, latitude, longitude, radius_meters, active toggle, current GPS helper), and persist official_locations.

Redesign Next-Step UI into a Compact 2-Step Zero-Scroll Flow (100dvh): Step 1 combines [พิกัดสถานที่ (ในสถานที่/นอกสถานที่ + หมายเหตุ + พิกัด GPS) + ช่วงเวลา (กรณีปฏิบัติงานนอกเวลา)] in a single zero-scroll card with Yellow 'ถัดไป' button at bottom edge; Step 2 is [ถ่ายรูปยืนยันตัวตน] with Green 'บันทึกลงเวลาปฏิบัติงาน' button at bottom edge, while preserving all existing DOM IDs.

Implement Combined Step 1 (Location + Overtime Shift) -> Step 2 (Photo Capture & Submit), Multi-Location Haversine Geofencing (evaluateOnsiteGeofence with 25m accuracy buffer), Onsite/Offsite mode switching, Offsite remark chips + 'อื่นๆ' modal input, Offsite 2-option GPS (Current GPS vs Manual Search modal), and the 3-stage Popup sequence (Summary Confirm -> 'ระบบกำลังบันทึกข้อมูล' -> 'ลงเวลาปฏิบัติงานเรียบร้อยแล้ว').

Support saving remark (work format option / custom 'อื่นๆ' text) and check-in / check-out GPS coordinates & location names for both Onsite and Offsite modes during check-in, check-out, single-click, and overtime flows.
Add Hierarchical Organization Filter Dock (#hierarchicalPersonnelOrgFilterDock: 1. สำนักงาน/กอง > 2. ส่วน/ฝ่าย > 3. กลุ่มงาน) matching reports.html for SuperAdmin and Admin (bureau scope).

Implement #initHierarchicalOrgFilter(), #populateHierarchicalOrgFilter(), #updateFilterDivisionOptions(), #updateFilterWorkGroupOptions(), and filter personnel table & export by selected Bureau/Division/WorkGroup for SuperAdmin and Admin (ขอบเขต สำนักงาน/กอง).
